newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bolivia-Brazil pipeline tender due in Nov - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia-Brazil pipeline tender due in Nov - paper.

text.p: The president of Brazilian state oil giant Petroleo Brasileiro SA - Petrobras said the tender document for the construction of the Bolivia-Brazil gas pipeline would be published in November, a financial newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Gazeta Mercantil quoted Joel Renno as saying the document would include tenders for equipment such as compressors, valves and tubing.
Construction of the 1,900-mile (3,000 km) pipeline, which links Bolivia's gas fields with Brazil's industrial heartland, is due to start by the end of this year or early 1997.
The $1.8 billion project is due to come on line in late 1998.
Renno also said Petrobras had around 200 projects worth $10-12 billion in investments which were suitable to be carried out in partnership with the private sector, Gazeta Mercantil reported.

He said these projects could be launched over the next four years if Congress approved legislation enacting last year's constitutional amendment which opens Brazil's state oil monopoly to private sector participation.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
